grade_2a.title: Shenshen's Busy Morning
grade_2a.summary: 跟着申申一起度过元气满满的早晨：起床、刷牙洗脸、享用早餐，准备开开心心上学去！

pages.sentenceEn: Ring, ring! Good morning, Shenshen! It is seven in the morning.
pages.sentenceCn: 叮铃铃！早上好，申申！现在是早上七点钟。

pages.sentenceEn: Time to get up! Shenshen gets out of bed with a big smile.
pages.sentenceCn: 该起床啦！申申面带大大的微笑从床上爬起来。

pages.sentenceEn: I brush my teeth and then wash my face. My face is fresh and clean!
pages.sentenceCn: 我刷牙然后洗脸。我的小脸蛋清新又干净！

pages.sentenceEn: Look at my checklist! Now I am dressed in my pretty clothes.
pages.sentenceCn: 看看我的备忘清单！现在我已经穿好漂亮的衣服了。

pages.sentenceEn: Mum says, 'Have breakfast, Shenshen!' 'Yes, Mum! Milk and eggs are delicious!'
pages.sentenceCn: 妈妈说：“申申，吃早餐啦！”“好的，妈妈！牛奶和鸡蛋真美味！”

pages.sentenceEn: 'I'm ready for school, Dad!' Shenshen takes her schoolbag and waves happily.
pages.sentenceCn: “爸爸，我准备好去上学了！”申申背起小书包，开心地挥挥手。

quiz.question: What does Shenshen do after brushing her teeth?
quiz.questionCn: 申申刷完牙之后做了什么？
quiz.explanation: 根据课文句子：'I brush my teeth and then wash my face'（我刷牙然后洗脸）。

quiz.question: Who says 'Have breakfast, Shenshen!'?
quiz.explanation: 根据课文：'Mum says: Have breakfast, Shenshen!'

quiz.question: Is Shenshen ready for school at the end?
quiz.questionCn: 故事最后申申准备好去上学了吗？
options: Yes, she is ready for school!
quiz.explanation: 根据最后一句：'I'm ready for school, Dad!'

grade_2a.title: The Mystery of the Messy Room
grade_2a.summary: 天哪，房间真是一团糟！小球到底躲到哪里去了？快和申申一起整理房间，找出红球吧！

pages.sentenceEn: Oh, look at the room! What a mess! Toys are on the floor.
pages.sentenceCn: 天哪，看看这个房间！真是一团糟！玩具都在地板上。

pages.sentenceEn: Where's my red ball? Is it on the desk? No, it isn't.
pages.sentenceCn: 我的红球在哪里呢？它在书桌上吗？不，不在上面。

pages.sentenceEn: Look under the bed! Oh, yes! The red ball is under the bed!
pages.sentenceCn: 看床底下！哦，找到了！红色的球就在床底下！

pages.sentenceEn: Mum says, 'Let's tidy the room together!' Shenshen says, 'All right!'
pages.sentenceCn: 妈妈说：“咱们一起整理房间吧！”申申说：“好的，没问题！”

pages.sentenceEn: What about the toys? Put them in the big toy box!
pages.sentenceCn: 那玩具呢？把它们收进大玩具箱里！

pages.sentenceEn: Put the storybooks on the shelf. The shelf looks so neat!
pages.sentenceCn: 把故事书放在书架上。书架看起来好整齐！

pages.sentenceEn: My room is tidy now! I like it very much! Good job, Shenshen!
pages.sentenceCn: 我的房间现在真整洁！我非常喜欢它！做得很棒，申申！

quiz.question: Where did Shenshen find her red ball?
quiz.questionCn: 申申在哪里找到了她的小红球？
quiz.explanation: 故事第3页：'Look under the bed! The red ball is under the bed!'

quiz.question: Where should the toys be put?
quiz.explanation: 故事第5页：'What about the toys? Put them in the big toy box!'

quiz.question: Where are the books placed?
quiz.questionCn: 书本被整齐地放在哪里？
quiz.explanation: 故事第6页：'Put the storybooks on the shelf.'

grade_2a.title: A Postcard from London
grade_2a.summary: 申申收到了一张来自伦敦的精美明信片，上面有大红色的双层巴士和著名的伦敦地铁！快来认识各种有趣的交通方式吧！

pages.sentenceEn: Look! Here is a postcard from London! Lily sends it to Shenshen.
pages.sentenceCn: 看！这是一张来自伦敦的明信片！莉莉寄给申申的。

pages.sentenceEn: Wow, look at the big red bus! Shenshen says, 'I love this red bus!'
pages.sentenceCn: 哇，看这辆大大的红色公共汽车！申申说：“我喜欢这个红色公交车！”

pages.sentenceEn: But what's this? Oh, it's the London Underground! Trains go fast under the ground.
pages.sentenceCn: 但是这是什么？哦，它是伦敦地铁！列车在地下跑得飞快。

pages.sentenceEn: 'How do you go to school, Shenshen?' Mum asks. 'Go by car? No, we don't.'
pages.sentenceCn: 妈妈问：“申申，你怎么去学校呀？乘汽车去吗？不，我们不坐汽车。”

pages.sentenceEn: 'I go to school by bus!' Shenshen says happily. 'The bus is big and fun.'
pages.sentenceCn: “我乘公交去学校！”申申开心地说。“公交车又大又有趣。”

pages.sentenceEn: 'Sometimes I go on foot with Dad. We walk and talk on the way.' 'I see, that is great!'
pages.sentenceCn: “有时我和爸爸一起走路去。我们在路上边走边聊。”“我知道啦，那太好啦！”

quiz.question: Where is the postcard from?
quiz.explanation: 第一页提到：'Here is a postcard from London.'（这是一张来自伦敦的明信片）。

quiz.question: What does Shenshen love on the postcard?
quiz.questionCn: 申申喜欢明信片上的什么？
options: The big red bus (红色大公交车)
quiz.explanation: 第二页课文：'I love this red bus!'（我喜欢这个红色公交车！）

quiz.question: How does Shenshen usually go to school?
quiz.explanation: 第五页课文：'I go to school by bus!'（我乘公交去学校！）

grade_2a.title: Do Our Best on Sports Day!
grade_2a.summary: 操场上真热闹！跑步、跳远、踢足球、打篮球，还有精彩的乒乓球挑战！快和申申一起做热身运动，勇敢试一试吧！

pages.sentenceEn: It is Sports Day at school! We love to play sports. We can run fast and jump high!
pages.sentenceCn: 今天是学校运动会！我们热爱做运动。我们可以跑得快、跳得高！

pages.sentenceEn: Coach says, 'But you should do a warm-up first! Let's do our best today!'
pages.sentenceCn: 教练说：“但你们应该先做热身运动！今天让我们竭尽全力！”

pages.sentenceEn: Lily plays ping-pong. Shenshen says, 'Wow, you can play ping-pong very well. Can I have a go?'
pages.sentenceCn: 莉莉在打乒乓球。申申说：“哇，你乒乓球打得非常好。我能试一试吗？”

pages.sentenceEn: Shenshen hits the ping-pong ball hard. 'Oh, no! The ball's out!' Shenshen says.
pages.sentenceCn: 申申用力击打乒乓球。“哦，不！球出界了！”申申说道。

pages.sentenceEn: 'Try again, Shenshen!' Lily smiles. Shenshen hits a great shot! 'Well done!'
pages.sentenceCn: “再试一次，申申！”莉莉微笑着鼓励。申申打出了漂亮的一球！“做得好！”

pages.sentenceEn: After ping-pong, the children cheer, 'Let's play football and play basketball together!'
pages.sentenceCn: 打完乒乓球后，孩子们欢呼道：“我们一起踢足球、打篮球吧！”

quiz.question: What should the children do before playing sports?
quiz.questionCn: 做运动之前，孩子们应该先做什么？
quiz.explanation: 根据课文重点句型：'But you should do a warm-up.'（但你应该做热身运动。）

quiz.question: What does Shenshen say when she wants to try playing ping-pong?
quiz.questionCn: 当申申想尝试打乒乓球时，她是怎么说的？
options: Can I have a go? (我能试一试吗？)
quiz.explanation: 根据课文句子：'Wow, you can play ping-pong very well. Can I have a go?'

quiz.question: When the ball is out, what does Lily say to encourage Shenshen?
quiz.questionCn: 当球出界时，莉莉说了什么来鼓励申申？
quiz.explanation: 根据故事第5页：'Try again, Shenshen!'（再试一次，申申！）

grade_2a.title: Rita's Magical Sky Log
grade_2a.titleCn: 莉塔的奇妙天空观察记
grade_2a.summary: 从清晨太阳升起、正午白云朵朵，到夜晚明月与钻石般闪亮的繁星，跟着莉塔一起记录天空的奇妙变化吧！

pages.sentenceEn: Hello! Look, this is my sky log. In the morning, the sun comes up. Good morning, Mr Sun!
pages.sentenceCn: 你好！看，这是我的天空记录。在早晨，太阳升起来了。早上好，太阳先生！

pages.sentenceEn: Where's Mr Sun now? Oh, he is behind the clouds! I like the white clouds. They're white and soft.
pages.sentenceCn: 现在太阳先生在哪里？哦，他在云朵的后面！我喜欢白云，它们又白又软。

pages.sentenceEn: In the afternoon, Mr Sun comes out again. The sun is high in the sky. It's big and yellow!
pages.sentenceCn: 到了下午，太阳先生又出来了。太阳高高挂在天空中，它又大又黄！

pages.sentenceEn: In the evening, the sun goes down in the west. The moon comes out in the evening.
pages.sentenceCn: 傍晚时分，太阳在西边落下。月亮在傍晚出来了。

pages.sentenceEn: At night, the moon and the stars come out. I can see small stars in the sky. They're small and bright!
pages.sentenceCn: 在夜晚，月亮和星星都出来了。我能看到天空中的小星星，它们又小又亮！

pages.sentenceEn: The little star is like a diamond in the sky. Good night, Mr Sun! Good night, moon and stars!
pages.sentenceCn: 小星星就像天空中的一颗钻石。晚安，太阳先生！晚安，月亮和星星！

quiz.question: When does the sun come up?
quiz.explanation: 根据故事第1页：'In the morning, the sun comes up.'（早晨，太阳升起。）

quiz.question: Where is Mr Sun when Rita cannot see him clearly?
quiz.questionCn: 当莉塔找不到太阳先生时，太阳先生躲在哪里？
options: Behind the clouds (在云朵的后面)
quiz.explanation: 根据故事第2页：'Where's Mr Sun now? Oh, he is behind the clouds!'（他在云朵的后面！）

quiz.question: What comes out at night and looks like a diamond?
quiz.questionCn: 什么在夜晚出来，并且像一颗钻石？
quiz.explanation: 根据故事第6页：'The little star is like a diamond in the sky.'（小星星像天空中的一颗钻石。）
